rules.title: Project policy is valid
rules.description: The project policy conforms to the portable policy contract.

rules.title: Declared and observed architecture agree
rules.description: Declared modules, hosts, projects, and project names match repository observation.

rules.title: Modules have semantic contracts
rules.description: Every observed module has a schema-valid semantic contract and local AGENTS.md router.

rules.title: Module identity matches its root
rules.description: A module contract id is the normalized name of its module root.

rules.title: Modules represent functional capabilities
rules.description: Technical categories are not represented as product modules.

rules.title: Application behavior has a cohesive feature owner
rules.description: Observed feature roots match policy; semantic cohesion is surfaced for review.

rules.title: Host source stays in declared adapter locations
rules.description: Host source paths are confined to explicitly declared adapter and composition locations. This path rule does not prove behavioral purity.

rules.title: Modules do not depend on hosts
rules.description: No module-owned project or source namespace has a dependency on a host-owned project or namespace.

rules.title: Cross-module access uses public contracts
rules.description: A cross-module project or source dependency targets a declared contract boundary.

rules.title: Project dependencies are authorized
rules.description: Every observed project dependency is explicitly allowed by project policy.

rules.title: Authoritative data has one owner
rules.description: Declared ownership is unique and observed writes are reviewed when an analyzer is unavailable.

rules.title: Architecture changes have a recorded decision
rules.description: Material policy growth and reductions in normative enforcement relative to a Git base require an existing decision reference and explicit review.

rules.title: Speculative structure is prohibited
rules.description: Catch-all directories and generated structural fields in semantic contracts are prohibited; material boundary changes are reviewed through CHG001 and repository governance.

rules.title: Normative and architectural references resolve
rules.description: Rule references, normative classifications, invariants, and ADR references resolve with complete validator-heading coverage.

rules.title: Waivers are explicit, bounded, and current
rules.description: Waivers bind current rule semantics, known authority, a valid scope, and an unexpired decision.

rules.title: Architecture authority is declared and repository-protected
rules.description: Review authorities resolve to CODEOWNERS principals and declare controls consistent with either team or solo-maintainer governance.

rules.title: Semantic reviews are explicit and current
rules.description: Review acknowledgements bind current rule semantics, a known finding fingerprint, scope, authority, repository revision, and mode-specific platform evidence.
